title: Yaji-Ring-Ring
author: Ambrose
rules:
Rules

Shading: Shade some cells so that no two shaded cells are orthogonally adjacent. Clues cannot be shaded, and represent the number of shaded cells in a straight line in the indicated direction.

Ring-ring: Draw rectangular loops through the centers of empty (non-shaded non-clued) cells so that every empty cell gets used. The sides of different rectangles may intersect each other, but not turn at their intersection or otherwise overlap.

Here is a small example to illustrate the rules. You can try solving the example online in Penpa+ or
Sudokupad.

solutionCode: Enter the contents of column 3, top to bottom, encoded as: H=horizontal segment, V=vertical segment, C=corner (any orientation), X=crossing segments, and S=shaded cell.
